node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-5 relations reduce to a pair quadratic and two Dickson equations
node.statement: Over any official field, every reduced signed weight-5 relation satisfying P(omega)=P(omega^3)=0 admits the following exact normalization. Scale one signed root to 1 and choose two others x,y; with u=x+y, A=xy, v=-1-u, B=u(v-A)/v, the final two roots are exactly the roots of T^2-vT+B. Conversely any guarded pair whose quadratic has two distinct mu_1024 roots reconstructs a relation. With D_0=2, D_1=v, D_m=vD_(m-1)-B D_(m-2), quadratic membership is equivalent to B^1024=1 and D_1024(v,B)=2. This is a two-shape-variable router, not an emptiness theorem.
